description: Declared foreground/background pairings for the Zeros token palette, with WCAG 2.2 contrast ratios and reviewed supplemental/boundary floors in BOTH themes. Asserted by apps/desktop/src/renderer/shared/theme/__tests__/contrast-contract.test.ts and rendered into docs/design-tokens.md. A pairing that is not listed here is not a sanctioned combination.

text.why: WCAG 1.4.3 AA for normal-size text; Zeros chrome text is 10–14px, never 'large'.

graphic.why: WCAG 1.4.11: icons, status dots, and control boundaries that carry meaning.

focus.why: WCAG 1.4.11 / 2.4.11: an opaque focus indicator against every surface it can sit on.

supplemental.why: Quietest metadata tier: owner-chosen 3:1 floor, below AA by design. Hovered/selected rows step it up to fg3.

boundary.why: Control outlines must stay perceptible on every surface controls sit on: a perceptibility floor, not a WCAG claim. highlighted-bg is excluded because controls do not sit on the user-message bubble. Resting outlines are subtle by reviewed design, below WCAG 1.4.11’s 3:1; focus is the strong cue.

boundary-hover.why: Hover/open outlines must read stronger on every control surface: a perceptibility floor, not a WCAG claim. highlighted-bg is excluded because controls do not sit on the user-message bubble.

pairs.why: Emphasis, default and secondary text meet AA at rest.
Supplemental metadata at rest; hovered/selected rows use fg3.
Hovered/selected rows step text up one tier; muted-fg is never the resting tier on a hover fill.
Standalone status text and counts (+N / −N) on app surfaces, including hovered rows and buttons.
Text on a tinted container uses the family -fg.

Text over code-editor search-match washes (35% match, 55% selected match). Editor text uses the syntax theme foreground, which sits at the fg1 end of the ladder; syntax token colors are a separate system.
Solid destructive fills at rest and on hover.
Yellow icons and status dots; yellow-primary is the darker text role.
Subtle resting control outlines on the surfaces controls sit on.
Hover/open outline on the same control surfaces.
The opaque focus core; halos (/50) are decoration on top of it.

ladders.why: Each foreground tier is at least 15% less contrast than the one above it, in both themes.
The hover/open control outline must have at least 15% more contrast than its resting outline on bg2.

exempt.why: Decorative surface separators; never the only cue for a control or state. Control outlines border3/4 have their own reviewed perceptibility floors.
Tinted/grouping washes; meaning is carried by their text and icons.
